spec.forecast_for: semester 6, from data known at the end of semester 5
spec.fields: id, targetType (student|segment), targetId, targetLabel, department, action, reason, owner, ownerId, priority, priorityScore, expectedImpact, dueInDays, triggeredBy, ruleId, outcomes
spec.priority_rule: student score = max over the rule's outcomes of (severity weight x probability) + 0.05 per additional High outcome, capped at 1; segment score = 0.85 x max(weight x mean risk) + 0.15 x min(1, members / 15% of students); Critical >= 0.8, High >= 0.6, Medium >= 0.4, else Low

rules.summary: High academic standing but a low chance of being placement-ready: coding bootcamp plus mock interviews
Attendance low or falling and the engagement-drop forecast is flagged: weekly mentor check-in and attendance contract
Active backlog with a flagged chance of not clearing it: remedial classes and a supplementary exam plan
No backlog yet but a flagged chance of failing: pre-emptive revision plan for the weakest subjects
High chance of an SGPA below 6: peer tutoring in the weakest subjects and monthly internal-marks review
Low assignment submission or high lateness alongside a flagged outcome: study-skills and time-management workshop
Round 1 flag Low but the model sees risk: an early, informal mentor conversation
Several outcomes High at once: a combined recovery plan with escalation
Stable high performers: stretch opportunities (hackathon, internship referral)

spec.caveat: Synthetic data. Recommendations are decision support for a mentor to review, not automatic actions.
